recognize_zh: 皮膚切片低倍下，真皮內有多個緻密、邊界清楚的淋巴球浸潤，集中圍繞血管與附屬器（perivascular/periadnexal），表皮大致未受侵犯；需結合血液中 T-PLL 病史與免疫染色確認。
features: Dense nodular lymphoid infiltrates in superficial and mid dermis
Perivascular and periadnexal distribution around vessels and eccrine structures
Infiltrates composed of small to medium dark lymphoid cells at this power
Interstitial scattered lymphocytes between dermal collagen bundles
Epidermis largely intact without obvious epidermotropism at this magnification
describe_en: Skin biopsy at low power shows multiple dense, sharply circumscribed lymphoid infiltrates centered on dermal blood vessels and adnexal structures in the superficial and mid dermis, with lighter interstitial infiltration. The overlying epidermis is largely intact and no epidermotropism is evident at this magnification. Cytologic detail is limited at this power. In a patient with known T-prolymphocytic leukemia and a matching T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by T-PLL.

ddx.vs: CLL skin infiltrates are also perivascular/periadnexal but are CD20+/CD5+/CD23+ B cells rather than TCL1+ T cells.
MF shows epidermotropism with Pautrier microabscesses and band-like dermal infiltrate rather than nodular perivascular aggregates.
Reactive infiltrates are sparser, polymorphous and accompanied by interface or epidermal changes without monotonous atypical T cells.
